title: Destination-Conditioned Adaptation with Semantic-Geometric Alignment for Generative Inbetweening

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种新的生成性插帧方法，通过目的地条件自适应和语义-几何对齐来改进预训练模型的性能。 Generative inbetweening aims to synthesize temporally coherent intermediate frames between a start frame and a target frame. Although pretrained image-to-video diffusion models provide strong priors for large-motion inbetweening, they are not explicitly designed to reach a specified target frame. They may therefore generate realistic individual frames while drifting from the target or producing unstable motion under large displacements and non-rigid dynamics. We propose DSG-GI, a framework that adapts pretrained latent video diffusion models through \textbf{D}estination-Conditioned Adaptation and \textbf{S}emantic-\textbf{G}eometric Alignment. Destination-Conditioned Adaptation treats the target frame as the destination of the sequence and provides temporally progressive guidance along the generated trajectory. Semantic-Geometric Alignment aligns the token-wise spatio-temporal relational geometry of backbone features with that of a frozen video foundation encoder and applies a flow-matching-aware latent flow constraint to samples near the data endpoint of the probability path. Together, these components strengthen destination guidance and preserve coherent semantic-geometric motion structure. Extensive experiments on standard and large-motion inbetweening benchmarks demonstrate improvements in temporal stability, target-frame faithfulness, and perceptual quality. Our code will be made publicly available.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种新的生成性插帧方法，通过目的地条件自适应和语义-几何对齐来改进预训练模型的性能。生成性插帧旨在合成起始帧与目标帧之间在时间上连贯的中间帧。 尽管预训练的图像到视频扩散模型为大幅运动插帧提供了强大的先验知识，但它们并未被明确设计用于达到指定的目标帧。 因此，它们可能会生成逼真的单帧图像，但会偏离目标帧，或在存在大位移和非刚性动态时产生不稳定的运动。 我们提出了 DSG-GI，一个通过 \textbf{D}estination-Conditioned Adaptation（目的地条件自适应）和 \textbf{S}emantic-\textbf{G}eometric Alignment（语义-几何对齐）来适配预训练潜在视频扩散模型的框架。 目的地条件自适应将目标帧视为序列的终点，并沿着生成的轨迹提供时间上渐进的引导。 语义-几何对齐将主干特征的逐令牌时空关系几何与冻结的视频基础编码器中的几何对齐，并对概率路径数据端点附近的样本应用一种感知流匹配的潜在流约束。 这些组件共同增强了目的地引导，并保留了连贯的语义-几何运动结构。 在标准插帧和大幅运动插帧基准上的广泛实验表明，该方法在时间稳定性、目标帧保真度和感知质量方面均有提升。 我们的代码将向公众开放。
